note: Set B reproduces all of Set A's claims and adds five correct wiring-schedule facts (150 conduit 2-1/2"C and #4G ground, 34 conductors 6#10 and 1"C conduit, item 33 #10G ground) that Set A omits, giving B materially better coverage of the schedule. B's one real defect is the claim 'Wiring 113 | 3#4/0 | AL, ARMORED CABLE' with quote '113 AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE': 113 is the lot number in the title block, the schedule item is 151, and that quote does not exist on the page. Both sets share the same error of reading '3W' as the phase of the sub-panel (the note reads 1~, 3W, i.e. single-phase, three-wire) and both state the 50A/2P main breaker twice under different entities. On balance B's five additional correct, substantive claims outweigh its single misread claim.
remarks: The text layer is badly jumbled: schedule symbol numbers are separated from their description rows (e.g. '50 AL: 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C.' is almost certainly the 150 row, and '150'/'20'/'31' float free of their lines), so row-to-description binding was judged mainly from the page image and from claims both sets agree on. Both sets bind the 50A/2P main-breaker and NEMA 3R enclosure facts to the vague entity 'NEMA 3R ENCLOSURE' rather than to the SUB-PANEL PV of note 2; the NEC 690.42 exception / ground-fault bonding note (item 7) is claimed by neither set.
